ui.about_lead: Wanpela buk bilong weta i stap redi long fon i no nidim intanet, na i save kisim laip taim yu askim. Save bilong weta oltaim bilong olgeta hap bilong graun i stap redi pinis long fon na yu ken ridim taim i no gat intanet; sindaun bilong nau, tok save, tok lukaut, na ol piksa lain i kam tasol taim yu askim.
ui.about_cred:
• Save bilong weta oltaim — WMO Climatological Standard Normals 1991–2020, long rot bilong NOAA / NCEI. Em i bilong olgeta manmeri.
  • Save oltaim ol i bin kaunim (bilong pulapim olgeta hap) — NASA POWER (MERRA-2), 2001–2020. Em i bilong olgeta manmeri.
  • Sindaun bilong nau na tok save — Open-Meteo. CC BY 4.0.
  • Stori bilong bipo na sekim gen — Open-Meteo Archive (ERA5). CC BY 4.0.
  • Tok lukaut bilong Amerika — US National Weather Service (api.weather.gov). Em i bilong olgeta manmeri.
  • Tok lukaut bilong kantri (Tailan) — Thai Meteorological Department (TMD). Em i bilong olgeta manmeri.
  • Nius bilong weta long olgeta hap bilong graun — GDACS, European Commission (JRC) / UN OCHA. CC BY 4.0.
  • Ol piksa lain bilong weta — © OpenWeatherMap (yu wokim wantaim ki nating bilong yu yet).
  • Ol nambis, baundri, na painim ples — Natural Earth. Em i bilong olgeta manmeri.
  • Nem bilong ol ples long Tailan — Nem bilong Wikidata. CC0.
  • Rot bilong ol bikpela win — NOAA IBTrACS.
  • Piksa bilong Equal Earth — Šavrič, Patterson & Jenny (2018), kaunim insait long ap.
ui.about_privacy: Ol pin bilong haus bilong yu na ki bilong OpenWeatherMap i stap tasol long dispela browser na ol i no save go long narapela ples. Ap i statim taim i no gat intanet tru; em i save go painim save bilong nau tasol taim yu askim, na salim tasol ol namba bilong ples yu nidim.
ui.about_foot: Weatherglass — em i nating na inap wok taim i no gat intanet. Olgeta save i soim taim bilong en; taim i no gat intanet, save oltaim i stap yet i strong.

ui.disc_body:
Weatherglass em wanpela tul bilong givim save, em i no wanpela wok bilong lukautim laip. Save bilong weta, tok save, ol stori bilong bipo, na tok lukaut ol i kisim long narapela ples (Open-Meteo, MET Norway, US National Weather Service, ol gavman ofis bilong weta bilong kantri, GDACS, na OpenWeatherMap taim yu putim ki bilong yu yet). Ol dispela save inap kam les, i no pulap, i no stret, o i no stap redi, na Weatherglass inap paulim o em i no soim gut.

No ken yusim dispela ap bilong wokim disisen we laip, helt, samting bilong yu, o sef bilong wokabaut i stap namel — dispela i insaitim bikpela win, wara i kapsait, balus, sip i wokabaut long solwara, wokabaut long maunten, o wok autsait. Yu mas bihainim tok bilong ofis bilong weta bilong hap bilong yu na ol tok lukaut bilong gavman; ol tok lukaut bilong ol i winim olgeta samting i soim long hia.

Buk bilong weta i stap redi long fon i soim namel save bilong longpela taim (1991–2020) na ol rekot bilong bipo. Em i tokim yu long sindaun i save kamap, i no soim wanem weta bai kamap long wanpela de stret.

Ples em i yusim tasol taim yu tasim bilong yusim, bilong kisim weta bilong dispela ples tasol, na mipela i no save holimpas dispela save. Ol pin bilong haus bilong yu na ol seting i stap tasol long dispela fon.

Weatherglass i kam nating, “olsem em i stap”, i no gat wanpela promis. Long olgeta rot lo i orait long en, man i wokim dispela ap i no karim wanpela bel hevi bilong lus o bagarap i kamap long yusim o bilipim tru ol save insait long en.

Taim yu tasim Mi save gut na mi orait long en yu tok tru olsem yu bin ridim dispela tok. Em bai i soim yu gen bihain long olgeta nupela apdet.
